modules.zh_lead: 在浏览器中打开正式入口 https://thesis-review.sjtu.edu.cn，使用本人校园账号登录。首次使用可先选择界面语言。
modules.en_lead: Open https://thesis-review.sjtu.edu.cn in your browser and sign in with your own SJTU account. You can choose the interface language before signing in.
zh_steps: 在登录页左下角选择中文或 EN。
点击“使用 jAccount 登录”，按校园统一身份认证页面的提示完成认证。
返回系统后进入“论文上传”。从邮件链接进入时，登录后将返回对应报告。
en_steps: Select 中文 or EN at the lower left.
Select Sign in with jAccount and follow the university authentication prompts.
After signing in, open Upload thesis. If you followed a report link in an email, you will return to that report.
modules.zh_note: 请使用提交论文时的同一账号查看报告。在公共电脑上操作后，记得退出登录。
modules.en_note: Use the same account that submitted the thesis to open its report. Sign out when you finish on a shared computer.

modules.zh_lead: 左侧选择“论文上传”，点击上传区域选择文件，也可将文件拖入该区域。每次提交一份论文。
modules.en_lead: Select Upload thesis in the sidebar. Click the upload area to choose a file, or drag it into the area. Submit one thesis at a time.
zh_steps: 文件必须是需要检测的学位论文，不能上传其他用途的 PDF 文件。
文件必须是含可选择、可复制文字的 PDF，不超过 50 MB。不能使用扫描版或纯图片 PDF。
核对页面显示的文件名和版本；选错时先移除，再重新选择。
展开“检测规则”确认范围后，点击“开始检测”。规则选择见下一页。
en_steps: The file must be the degree thesis you want to review. Do not upload an unrelated PDF.
Use a text-based PDF with selectable, copyable text, no larger than 50 MB. Scanned or image-only PDFs are not supported.
Check the displayed filename and version. Remove an incorrect file before choosing another.
Open Choose checks, confirm the scope, and select Start review. Check selection is explained on the next page.
modules.zh_note: 提交前可在本地 PDF 阅读器中尝试选择并复制一段正文。无法选中文字时，请从 Word 或 LaTeX 源文件重新导出文字版 PDF。
modules.en_note: Before uploading, try selecting and copying a paragraph in a PDF reader. If the text cannot be selected, export a text-based PDF from the Word or LaTeX source.
modules.zh_caption: 确认论文文件与开始检测入口
modules.en_caption: Confirm the thesis file before starting

modules.zh_title: 选择检测规则与确认额度
modules.en_title: Select checks and check your allowance
modules.zh_lead: 展开检测规则，按需要选择格式规范、内容规范以及论点论据审查中的检查项。已选数量会同步更新。
modules.en_lead: Expand the check selector and choose the relevant checks under Formatting, Content, and Claims and evidence. The selected-check count updates as you make changes.
zh_steps: 使用整体或分组的“全选／清空”，也可逐项勾选。至少保留一项可用规则。
阅读规则描述，确认检查对象。紫色烧瓶“实验性”表示试验阶段的功能，结果需要谨慎复核。
确认论文与规则后开始检测。普通用户每天可成功生成 3 份报告，北京时间次日 00:00 刷新。
en_steps: Use Select all or Clear for the whole list or a group, or select individual checks. Keep at least one available check selected.
Read each description to understand its scope. A purple flask marked Beta identifies an experimental feature; review its results carefully.
Confirm the file and checks, then start. Regular users can generate up to three reports per day. The allowance resets at 00:00 Beijing time.
modules.zh_note: 仅成功生成报告计次，失败或取消不计次。进行中的任务暂占名额；新检测与增量补跑共用额度。删除报告不退次数。以账号当前可用额度为准。
modules.en_note: Only successfully generated reports count. Failed or cancelled reviews do not count. Active tasks temporarily reserve capacity. New and resumed reviews share the allowance; deleting a report does not restore a use.
modules.zh_caption: 选择检查项；紫色烧瓶表示实验性功能
modules.en_caption: Check selection; the purple flask indicates a beta feature

modules.en_title: Track progress or stop a review
modules.zh_lead: 开始后，页面显示上传、排队及规则执行进度。预计时间会随处理情况变化，并非固定完成时间。
modules.en_lead: The page shows upload, queue and check progress. The estimated time changes with processing conditions and is not a guaranteed completion time.
zh_steps: 查看当前阶段、完成数量与预计时间。请勿因等待而重复提交同一任务。
需要中止时点击“停止检测”，等待服务器返回结果。只有页面确认取消成功，才表示任务已停止。
若提示“检测已完成，无法取消”，可查看报告或稍后查看；这不属于取消成功。
en_steps: Read the current stage, completed-check count and time estimate. Do not repeatedly submit the same task while waiting.
To stop, select Stop review and wait for the server response. The task is stopped only when cancellation is confirmed.
If the system says the review is already complete, open the report or view it later. This is not a successful cancellation.
modules.zh_note: 取消成功后不生成该次完成报告，也不发该次完成邮件。已被邮件服务器接收的邮件无法保证撤回。正常检测无需一直盯着页面，完成后可从通知或历史报告查看。 流程条的绿色对勾只表示该阶段完成，不代表论文无问题。
modules.en_note: A successfully cancelled review does not produce a completion report or send its completion email. Email already accepted by a mail server cannot be reliably recalled. You can return through Notifications or Report history. A green check on the progress bar marks a completed stage, not a thesis without issues.
modules.zh_caption: 进度、动态预计时间与停止检测入口
modules.en_caption: Progress, changing time estimate and the stop control

modules.en_title: Read results while checks are running
modules.zh_lead: 部分规则完成后，实时报告先显示已有结果，其余规则继续执行。数量可能继续变化，不能当作最终结论。
modules.en_lead: The live report shows available findings while other checks continue. Counts may change as more checks finish, so this is not the final review outcome.
zh_steps: 查看顶部汇总，了解当前已返回的结果数量。
选择右侧结果卡片或“跳到第…页”，查看对应论文位置。
留意蓝灰色旋转图标及“正在检测”；任务完成后再查看完整报告及各项执行状态。
en_steps: Read the summary for the findings returned so far.
Select a finding or its Go to Page link to locate the relevant thesis page.
Watch for the blue-grey spinner and In progress status. After completion, review the saved report and check execution statuses.
modules.zh_note: 英文说明准备期间可能显示翻译中的提示，请等待完成。论文原句和文件名保持原语言。本手册已隐藏截图中的论文摘录，画面中的数量仅为演示。
modules.en_note: A notice may appear while English explanations are being prepared. Wait for them to become available. Quotations and filenames retain their original language. Thesis excerpts are hidden in this guide; displayed counts are illustrative.
modules.zh_caption: 实时报告；论文摘录已隐藏
modules.en_caption: Live report with thesis excerpts omitted
